newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Most Australians support some privatisation - poll.
newsitem.headline: Most Australians support some privatisation - poll.

text.p: Most Australians support at least some privatisation, an opinion poll reported on Wednesday.
But the Morgan poll found people were less inclined to support privatisation in particular areas.
They supported privatisation in only two out of 10 industries that the pollsters suggested -- telephone services and urban transport.
Overall, 55 percent of voters supported some form of privatisation or another, a commentary on the poll said.
People who vote for the ruling Liberal-National coalition were far more likely (70 percent) to support privatisation than supporters of the opposition Labor party (37 percent).
Privatisation in telecoms and public transport was backed by 54 percent of people.
The next-best supported areas for privatisation were motorways (48 percent) and airports (47 percent).
Among industries nominated, the least supported area for privatisation was hospitals (26 percent).
